title: Genetics of Differences of Sex Development and Hypospadias
brief_summary: This study seeks to identify genetic causes of conditions that affect the gonads and genitals, and to study the impact on families of receiving genetic results.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Genital or gonadal abnormalities as evidenced by physical examination or imaging (including but not limited to hypospadias, microphallus, clitoromegaly, ambiguous genitalia), with no cause identified by standard clinical evaluation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to provide informed consent
